## Python floating-point boundary under hardening

The [separate FP addendum and selected decision](../../admission/FP-HARDENING-DECISION.md) first reproduced DAZ/FTZ Python Value/JSON/persistence loss. Further fresh CPython3.12.14 source analysis explains an isolated unmasked-SSE denormal trap in struct.pack's floating sentinel comparison. The selected minimal fix uses a public read-only exception-mask preflight before initial float extraction, private immutable canonical bit identity, integer-only later equality/hash/sort, and full supported-state checks over connection/codec/close lifecycle. Production pickle serialization was not selected; its successful diagnostic probe and the original SIGFPE remain separate evidence.

The storage owner's expanded suite currently passes56 restored isolated-control children, genuine no-engine persistence/close/reopen and unchanged typed/legacy suites as applicable. This is a preliminary result, not source release or full item-2 acceptance. Python new-float admission intentionally rejects unmasked exceptions; it is not claimed to have native bit primitives' state-independent admission. The guard is explicitly restricted to the validated CPython/Linux x86-64/little-endian/LP64/glibc2.41 target, unknown targets fail closed, and no caller FP controls are repaired or mutated.
